paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Hyang Sri Wisnu kembali, pemujaan perlindungan kembali, menjaga; Sri Wisnu kembali, memelihara kembali;
Menjaga Sri Wisnu pada segenap penjuru dijaga; inilah penjagaan pada segala penjuru, kepada Paramaksmi Sri. Inilah Paramaksmi Sri, keagungan yang melingkupi Sri, Trimurti berada di dalam hati (hredaya), bersemayam di dalam hati, itulah Paramaksmi sebagai penyebab persemayaman.

[Lembar 2]
Penyebab perlindungan Wisnu, dalam Trimurti, wujud kesatria utama, Sri Laksmi Wisnu dewa penguasa, pada Trimurti itulah hakikat tiga lapisan pelindung, persemayaman Paramaksmi di alam batin/hati (indraloka ring hrdaya), tegak kukuh (pratisthita) Paramaksmi.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
Lord Sri Vishnu again, the protective reverence again, protecting; Sri Vishnu again, preserving again;
Protecting Sri Vishnu across all directions, protected; this is the protection across the directions, unto Paramalaksmi Sri. This is Paramalaksmi Sri, divine presence surrounding Sri, the Trimurti within the heart (hridaya), dwelling in the heart, that is Paramalaksmi as the reason for inner dwelling.

[Leaf 2]
The cause of protection in Vishnu, within the Trimurti, the foremost manifestation of the kshatriya deity, Sri Lakshmi Vishnu, within the Trimurti that is the truth of the three protective sheaths, the realm of the heart (indraloka in hrdaya), established (pratisthita) is Paramalaksmi.
